reason: Alert is TP: User input from request.getParameter('BlCurated00074') flows directly to 'baz' (line 36) which is printed unsanitized in HTML at line 37. While HtmlUtils.htmlEscape() creates 'bar', the sink uses 'baz' (unsanitized copy of param), making this a confirmed XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User param extracted at L32, copied to baz at L36, printed unsanitized at L37
